title: RNA sequence design and protein-DNA specificity prediction with NA-MPNN.
authors: Kubaney, Andrew; Favor, Andrew; McHugh, Lilian; Mitra, Raktim; Pecoraro, Robert; Dauparas, Justas; Glasscock, Cameron; Baker, David
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文提出统一核酸逆折叠模型NA-MPNN，以图神经网络同时实现RNA序列设计与蛋白-DNA结合特异性预测，核心聚焦TF-DNA互作建模且方法高度契合AI方向。
abstract: RNA sequence design and protein-DNA binding specificity prediction can both be framed as nucleic acid inverse-folding problems: finding the most likely nucleic acid sequences given a fixed three-dimensional structure of a nucleic acid or nucleic acid-protein complex. While task-specific tools have been developed, no unified deep learning model for nucleic acid inverse folding has been described; a single model would have larger and more diverse datasets available for training and a considerably greater range of applicability. Here we introduce Nucleic Acid MPNN (NA-MPNN), a message-passing neural network that treats proteins, DNA, and RNA within a unified biopolymer graph representation. NA-MPNN outperforms previous methods on RNA sequence design and fixed-dock protein-DNA specificity prediction, and should be broadly useful for de novo RNA structure design and prediction of DNA-binding specificity.
abstract_zh: RNA序列设计与蛋白质-DNA结合特异性预测均可被构建为核酸逆折叠问题：即在给定核酸或核酸-蛋白质复合物的固定三维结构时，寻找最可能的核酸序列。尽管已有针对特定任务的工具被开发出来，但尚未有统一的深度学习模型用于核酸逆折叠；单一模型将拥有更大且更多样化的数据集用于训练，并具有显著更广泛的应用范围。在此，我们引入核酸MPNN（NA-MPNN），这是一种消息传递神经网络，在统一的生物聚合物图表示中处理蛋白质、DNA和RNA。NA-MPNN在RNA序列设计和固定对接蛋白质-DNA特异性预测方面优于先前方法，并应广泛适用于从头RNA结构设计和DNA结合特异性预测。
